metaDescription: What {brand} stocks, what it leaves out, and how ordering, dispatch from {dispatchFrom}, delivery and returns work.

hero.title: One shop for every animal in the house
hero.lead: {brand} stocks food, bedding, walking kit, trays, grooming tools, cages, tanks and terrarium equipment for dogs, cats, rabbits and other small animals, birds, fish and reptiles, delivered to the {countries}.

shelves.title: What we stock
shelves.rangeTitle: Sorted by animal, not by brand
shelves.rangeBody: Every product belongs to the animal it is made for, so you can start from the creature rather than from a manufacturer. These are the eight sections:
shelves.listingTitle: What you get on every listing

listing.new: New stock only. We list nothing second-hand, refurbished or ex-display.
listing.photo: A photograph of the product and a written description of what it is.
listing.stock: Live stock status. Anything that has run out is labelled “Sold out”.
listing.prices: A price you can read in {currencies}.

notSold.title: What we leave out
notSold.lead: A few categories are kept out of the range deliberately.

items.coldChain: Raw or frozen food that needs a cold chain

order.label: Order
order.body: Put what you need in the bag and pay by card ({cardMethods}). You can read prices in {currencies}.

dispatch.label: Dispatch
dispatch.body: We pack at {dispatchFrom} and normally get an order out within {processingDays} of the payment clearing.

delivery.label: Delivery & returns
delivery.delivery: Parcels reach the United Kingdom in {uk} and EU member states in {eu}. Standard delivery is {cost}, and nothing at all on orders of {threshold} or more.
delivery.returns: You have {days} days from the day the parcel arrives to change your mind, and you do not have to say why.
delivery.warranty: Anything faulty is covered for {months} months under our warranty.
